title: SwimBird: Eliciting Switchable Reasoning Mode in Hybrid Autoregressive MLLMs

rs.innovation_approach: 把预先固定的 text/latent/interleaved 推理模板改成由单一模型自回归选择的模式；用分模式 SFT 样本和不同损失建立文本与连续视觉生成能力。
rs.key_step: 先用 Qwen3VL-8B 对原图与附中间图分别作八次答案测量，过滤/标记 vision-only 或 interleaved 样本；再加入 50K text-only traces，以 CE+MSE 学习 delimiter 路由和连续 latent spans。
rs.why_non_obvious: 统一生成接口不足以避免所有题都注入 latent；监督数据必须同时包含无需 latent 的路径和视觉/混合路径，且连续 span 的长度不能强行统一。本文没有将这个主张独立于数据规模、来源和计算预算作因果验证。
rs.trigger_condition: When heterogeneous queries need different intermediate representations, apply mode-labeled supervision and autoregressive delimiters to achieve conditional representation selection.

rs.abstract_strategy: Make a fixed processing format selectable and supervise all supported execution paths.
rs.abstract_key_step: Compare unaided and assisted responses, assign training paths, and combine path-specific losses under generated boundary markers.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Preserve the inexpensive path in the training distribution while accommodating continuous intermediates whose needed length varies.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When one fixed processing format mismatches heterogeneous inputs, learn conditional switches from coverage of distinct successful paths.

A training instance may contain pure textual CoT, pure visual CoT, or interleaved segments. We optimize a unified objective that sums modality-specific losses over the activated segments:

objective.signal_routing: Textual spans receive shifted CE; continuous latent spans receive shifted MSE against intermediate-image encoder embeddings. Only activated segments contribute. Delimiters define routing; exact delimiter/answer masks are not enumerated. Only LLM parameters update; encoder and projector frozen. No per-action advantages/rewards/PG.
objective.normalization: other: Eqs.2/4 show sums over text positions and latent positions; no group mean/std, leave-one-out, or KL objective. Implementation reduction over batch, token count or embedding dimension is not specified; do not infer actual length normalization from the MSE name.
objective.invariance: No optimal-policy invariance theorem or potential-based shaping. Objective and SFT distribution change; retaining symbolic reasoning is an empirical author claim, not a guarantee.
objective.baseline_or_potential: No value baseline, critic or potential. Reconstruction targets are frozen vision encoder/projector outputs. Offline Qwen3VL-8B and Qwen3-235B judge curate data, not online reward baselines.
objective.degenerate_cases: K=0/text-only has no visual MSE; vision-only still emits a discrete final answer, not zero text supervision. λvis=0 removes explicit latent reconstruction (not experimentally tested here). No GRPO all-correct/all-wrong groups. Under Stage2 passhint=passbase=0, written retention rule retains sample and labels interleaved; reader deduction, not author-tested behavior. No reported guarantee against mode collapse after later RL; p≈0 is not solved by this SFT paper.

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Actual controlled tests are Nmax sweep (Nmin=2;16/32/64/128) and λvis sweep (0.1/0.2/0.5/1.0). Missing decisive test: same data, training budget and inference budget with adaptive versus forced fixed modes, shuffled mode labels, plus source-balanced controls.

evidence_design.falsifier: Reader-proposed: on held-out source-balanced examples and matched budgets, forced modes or shuffled labels match adaptive mode selection, or inferred mode fails to predict per-example utility of latent computation; then mode-routing explanation is unsupported. For efficiency, require measured costs and prespecified accuracy noninferiority.

pitfalls.text: Do not assume larger latent capacity helps: default maximum32 chosen because64/128 hurt HR8K; tune alongside general benchmarks.
pitfalls.quote: However, further expanding Nmax to 64 or 128 does not help and even degrades performance

pitfalls.text: Do not increase MSE weighting on one visual metric alone; 0.5 helps HR8K while harming RealWorldQA.
pitfalls.quote: In contrast, increasing λvis to 0.5 improves HRBench8K (75.9) but degrades RealWorldQA (72.0),

engineering.lesson: 当模型需要兼容无需额外视觉计算与视觉密集任务时，应在 SFT 中保留不同路径并分别监督；增加 latent 长度或重构权重会产生跨任务退化，应报告分任务准确率与实际成本，不能把模式分布或总分增益当必要性证据。

relevance.how: 用50K text-only和42.3K视觉/混合样本显式覆盖各模式，是先种行为的同类机制；并未测试 RL 新行为或保留。
按模型对有/无中间图的成功测量构造模式标签，可启发按需求分层，但不含不确定性触发或真实 crop 决策。
离线固定8B读者对 privileged 中间图的收益不等于当前4B策略自然crop收益，提供迁移边界而非解决方案。
分开原图/中间图像素预算并保留可变分辨率，提示应检查教师中间图目标与学生可见细节是否对齐。
同时报告视觉密集、一般VQA、数学任务，提供检查多路径训练是否伤害其他能力的评测组织方式。
